archetypes.name: straggler-timing
archetypes.rationale: The straggler cutoff spawns a subprocess inside the polling loop to compute the anchor, potentially biasing the deadline; also two emit_kv('WARN') calls can overwrite each other silently when both warnings fire.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the straggler deadline implementation in python/agent_waterfall.py, focusing on _reap_phase and _slot_collector_accepted. Examine whether the synchronous subprocess invocation inside _slot_collector_accepted contributes to the time.monotonic() elapsed time used to compute the deadline anchor, potentially making the anchor larger than the true wall-clock half-mark. Check the two emit_kv('WARN', ...) calls near the end of dispatch_waterfall: when both cost-fallback-exceeded-threshold and reviewer-straggler-dropped fire, verify which warning survives given that KV parsers typically take last-wins, and assess whether the first warning is silently dropped. Verify that _finish_launch removes launches from _ACTIVE_LAUNCHES and _DISPATCH_LAUNCHES correctly under both the normal exit path and the straggler kill path, and that no double-remove or missed-remove can occur. Confirm that _terminate_launch followed immediately by launch.process.poll() reliably returns a non-None exit code after _terminate_launch calls process.wait(). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dedup-key-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The finding dedup key falls back to stripped block body text when both Location and Concern are absent, risking collisions between distinct findings; zip strict=True raises on mismatched list lengths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the cross-round finding deduplication in python/plan_review.py, focusing on _finding_dedup_key, _read_applied_finding_keys, _record_applied_finding_keys, and the call site in plan_review_continuation. When both Location and Concern fields are absent from a finding block, the key falls back to the block body minus its numbered header; examine whether two structurally different findings could produce the same normalized key and cause a valid new finding to be incorrectly suppressed as a duplicate. Check whether zip(severities, new_flags, strict=True) and zip(blocks, new_flags, strict=True) can raise StopIteration under any reachable input conditions where the two lists could have different lengths. Verify that _record_applied_finding_keys is called unconditionally even in the cap-reached and ballot-items-lost early-exit branches, and assess whether recording keys in those branches is correct or could cause spurious suppression in a subsequent design session. Confirm that the atomic write in _record_applied_finding_keys leaves the ledger consistent if the process is killed between the mkstemp write and the replace. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: paths-file-contract
archetypes.rationale: The no_fallback guard removal from _write_paths_file and the ALL_OUTPUT_FILES loop silently changes behavior for all non-straggler runs that previously wrote empty-string entries for failed slots.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the behavioral change to _write_paths_file in python/agent_waterfall.py where the no_fallback condition was removed, and the parallel change to the ALL_OUTPUT_FILES loop. Previously, when no_fallback was False, empty final_outputs entries were written as-is into both the paths file and ALL_OUTPUT_FILES, giving callers positional alignment between slot index and output; now empty entries are unconditionally skipped for all runs. Examine all downstream consumers of the paths file and of the ALL_OUTPUT_FILES and ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS KV values to determine whether any caller depended on positional alignment or empty-string sentinel entries. Also review the dropped_slots_file write condition change from opts.no_fallback to any(drop.reason for drop in drops): verify that callers reading DROPPED_SLOTS_FILE handle unconditional presence correctly, and that the file is not written when there are zero drops (check the _write_drops early-return path). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
